name: Tom Cotton

pages.title: Tom Cotton – A sixth-generation Arkansan born in Yell County, an Army combat veteran, and a U.S. Senator fighting to make Arkansas safe and prosperous.
pages.text:
A strong military and billions in investments for Arkansas.
A secure border and a safer Arkansas.
Lower taxes for every Arkansan.
Senator Tom Cotton fights and delivers for Arkansas.
## Born in Yell County.
Forged in the Army.
Fighting for Arkansas.
Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family’s cattle farm in Yell County, Arkansas. He graduated from Dardanelle High School before going to Harvard and Harvard Law School.
After 9/11, Tom joined the Army as an Infantry Officer and served combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, with the 101st Airborne and at Arlington National Cemetery. His decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

From the farm to the factory floor, Tom Cotton uses his influence in the U.S. Senate to deliver for Arkansas.

How Cotton fights for us
## Helping make Arkansas safer and more prosperous.
Tom is putting Arkansas first on the issues that matter to working families across our state.
## Secure the border
Authored the RAISE Act, helped pass the Laken Riley Act to deport criminal illegals, and worked with President Trump to secure the border. 100% tough-on-illegal immigration voting record.
## Prosperous Arkansas
Decisive vote to pass the largest middle-class tax cut in history. Cotton ended the Obamacare tax on Arkansans and helped lower energy costs and healthcare costs.
## Arkansas: Defense Capital of America
Cotton used his position on the Armed Services Committee and his relationship with President Trump to deliver BILLIONS in defense investments, from Pine Bluff, Fort Ebbing, Little Rock, and more.
## Law & order
Backs the Blue 100% of the time. Helped stop legislation that would have freed violent criminals in Arkansas. Endorsed by law enforcement.
For a country that is strong and leaves no American behind. For an economy that rewards hard work. For a culture that stands for life and kneels only before God.

pages.title: Issues – Tom Cotton
pages.text:
## On the issues
Immigration & Our Sovereignty
Better Healthcare for Arkansas Families
## See Where Tom Stands:
Immigration & Our Sovereignty
America is a nation of laws, and a country without a border is not a country.
Senator Tom Cotton has been one of the strongest voices for securing the border and restoring American sovereignty. He backed President Trump’s border enforcement policies, fought to end catch-and-release, and pushed to finish the wall. He voted to pass the Laken Riley Act to deport criminal illegal aliens. He has consistently voted to deport criminal illegal aliens and crack down on drug and human trafficking that harms Arkansas communities.
Cotton authored the RAISE Act to fix our broken legal immigration system by ending chain migration and putting American workers first. His position is simple: the right amount of illegal immigration is zero, and Arkansas families should be protected from illegal immigration.
Lowering Prices for Working Arkansans
Joe Biden’s presidency resulted in the worst inflation in a generation. With President Trump inflation is way down, but Tom Cotton is fighting for even lower prices.
Senator Cotton has fought to lower costs by getting rid of the Democrats Green New Deal regulations and supporting American energy, which means lower costs for Arkansans and jobs right here at home. He helped pass the Working Families Tax Cut to put more money back in the pockets of Arkansas families. He also backed the largest tax cut in American history and has consistently voted against the spending that drove inflation higher.
He has also authored legislation to protect Arkansans from the costs associated with data centers.
National Security to Keep Arkansas Safe
Arkansas plays a critical role in America’s defense, and Senator Cotton has made sure our state stays at the center of it.
As a former Army officer and combat veteran, Cotton has fought to strengthen the military and deliver major investments for Arkansas military installations and defense industries. Senator Cotton has delivered billions in Arkansas investments in Pine Bluff, Fort Ebbing, and across the state. Those investments support good jobs in Arkansas and strengthen America’s ability to deter China, Russia, Iran, and terrorists.
Cotton has also led the fight against Communist China by protecting U.S. supply chains, stopping Chinese espionage, and defending American technology and industry.
Law and Order for Safe Families
Every Arkansas family deserves safe streets and secure communities.
Senator Cotton has pushed back against the Left’s soft-on-crime agenda by backing law enforcement, opposing defunding the police, and supporting tougher penalties for violent criminals, drug traffickers, and repeat offenders. Senator Cotton has been endorsed by leading Arkansas law enforcement officials and groups, and backs the blue 100%.
Arkansans know how to spend their money better than Washington does.
Senator Cotton helped pass the largest tax cut in American history, cutting taxes for families, workers, and small businesses across Arkansas. He has voted to stop tax hikes, oppose IRS expansion, and keep more of your paycheck in your pocket.
Senator Cotton passed no tax on tips, no tax on social security, and stopped the radical left from raising taxes on every Arkansan.
Better Healthcare for Arkansas Families
Senator Cotton has fought to protect rural hospitals, expand access to care, and lower prescription drug costs without turning healthcare over to bureaucrats. He has opposed one-size-fits-all government takeovers and worked to strengthen care for veterans and seniors in Arkansas.
Senator Cotton is responsible for ending the Obamacare Insurance Mandate that fined tens of thousands of Arkansas families for being unable to afford insurance.
Second Amendment Rights
The Second Amendment is a God-given right.
Senator Cotton has a strong pro Second Amendment record of standing up for law-abiding Arkansas gun owners. He has been endorsed by the National Rifle Association. He has opposed gun control schemes that punish honest citizens and instead pushed for tougher enforcement against violent criminals and gangs.
Protecting Arkansas Families from Radical Agendas
Arkansas values are under attack from radical ideologies pushed by the far left.
Senator Cotton has been a leader in fighting woke indoctrination in schools, Critical Race Theory, and policies that divide kids by race or undermine parents’ rights. He has also stood up for life, religious freedom, and the right of parents to raise their children without government interference. When the Arkansas legislature made Arkansas the first state to ban harmful trans surgeries on kids, Senator Cotton stood up for Arkansas against radical liberals that attacked our state.
Education: Putting Arkansas Parents & Students First
Senator Cotton has fought for local control of education, parental rights, and keeping radical ideology out of schools. He has opposed federal overreach and backed efforts to give Arkansas more authority over its schools.
Cotton supports school choice so parents can pick the best option for their children. He has pushed to keep politics out of the classroom and focus on reading, writing, math, history, and civics. He also supports higher teacher pay and policies that reward good teachers so Arkansas can attract and keep the best educators.
